title: A held change from a failed granted round prints an owner-item line, and the batch runner files the page item
why: Owner item 625 a with his condition (15:46 CST Nov 12): "as long as its flagged to me and doesn't go to sleep idling quietlky". Lane review-fix-check-round 15:48 CST: the hold for a failed granted round exists only in draft #2326; main reads a round-4 FAIL as done or open.
source: owner page save 15:46 CST Nov 12 (item 625); lane review-fix-check-round 15:48 CST
note: Lane pick (undoable, triage agrees): merge --reviewed prints one `held: owner item needed` line naming the PR and the choices (drop, restart, merge) and exits non-zero, so a runner cannot pass over it; the batch runner then files the page item. Red test first. After #2326 lands.
